purpose: Teach: 賠償/失業/暴力団/ヒトラー/文部省/王朝/満州/殺す

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、賠償、絶対、請求、絶対、警察、絶対、関連調査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling this case seriously—compensation claims, police investigation, all of it. Thank you for asking.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady breath. Each clause lands with calm certainty, not rushing. The weight of procedure in his voice, not burden.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 急激な、本気で、絶対、失業、絶対、増加、絶対、警察、絶対、治安、絶対、注視されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard unemployment's been rising sharply lately, and the police are monitoring the situation closely.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational. Slight pause before the key point. Gentle inquiry in the voice—he's working through the implications as he speaks. Not rehearsed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、暴力団、絶対、関連の、絶対、容疑者、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's right. We're investigating suspects connected to organized crime in relation to this case.
lines.style: Direct, procedurally confident. Clipped at the edges. The tone of someone stating facts he's certain of. No apology in it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 歴史展で、本気で、絶対、ヒトラー、絶対、関連の、絶対、展示、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、ご担当ですか?本気で、感謝
lines.en: Are you handling security at the historical exhibition—the one with the sensitive materials?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, respectfully framed. Softer attack than his earlier statements. He's asking because he wants to understand, not testing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。学校警備の、本気で、絶対、文部省、絶対、ガイドライン、絶対、警察、絶対、参考にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. For school security, we follow the guidelines set out by the Ministry of Education closely.
lines.style: Procedural, matter-of-fact. Emphasis on protocol and proper channels. The voice of someone who knows the framework and adheres to it without question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 歴史的な、本気で、絶対、王朝、絶対、宝物の盗難、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand there's an ongoing investigation into the theft of historical treasures from an important collection.
lines.style: Reflective, carefully phrased. He's acknowledging something delicate. Slower pace, measured. The respectfulness of not overstating or dramatizing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、地域、絶対、所縁の、絶対、犯罪、絶対、警察、絶対、対応中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's correct. We're currently handling a case involving crimes connected to the Manchuria region.
lines.style: Steady, historical weight beneath the words. Not rushed. He speaks as though this is part of a larger, older story. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、人を、絶対、殺す、絶対、ような、絶対、凶悪犯罪、絶対、対応、絶対、本当にご苦労ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Police work dealing with serious violent crimes—crimes that cost lives—that must take a real toll.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of the human cost. Slower pace, softer opening. There's respect in his voice, almost awe. Trailing slightly, giving space for the weight of it.
